subject: URGENT: Push motor-city-math live — exam is tomorrow
body:
FA — need you to push the motor-city-math site live tonight. Kai's exam is tomorrow.

The publish workflow is blocked because MOTOR_CITY_MATH_TOKEN needs to be rotated. Workflow: `.github/workflows/publish-to-motor-city-math.yml` in kai-algebra2-tests repo. Manual trigger only right now.

What needs to go live:
- Fractional Exponent Drill (data/frac-exp-drill.json) — new, just committed
- All of data/ including manifest.json (updated)
- index.html (drill added to registry at top)
- exam.html (no changes, but needs to match)

The workflow already handles copying data/ so once the token is fixed and publish runs, everything goes.

Two options:
1. Rotate the MOTOR_CITY_MATH_TOKEN secret in kai-algebra2-tests repo settings and trigger the workflow
2. Manually push the files to marcusash/motor-city-math repo directly

Either works. Fastest path wins — exam is tomorrow morning.

This is blocking Kai. Please action tonight.

FR
